checks.name: Task B: SRC_URL_RO read-only proof (Vercel Sandbox runner), re-verified after the db-operator's fix
checks.expected: `git diff scripts/migration/db/runner.mjs` limited to readOnlyScopedUrl + its export, building the options query by hand with %20 (never +), keeping sslmode, merging any existing options value, and leaving userinfo/host/port/path untouched; readonly-url.selftest.mjs and runner-guards.selftest.mjs both all-pass; a fresh Sandbox session opened with $SRC_URL_RO against the real source reports default_transaction_read_only=on and a CREATE TEMP TABLE write attempt fails
checks.actual: Diff re-derived myself: `git diff scripts/migration/db/runner.mjs` touches only the readOnlyScopedUrl function body/comment and the trailing export list (now a multi-line list including readOnlyScopedUrl) -- no other function changed. Independently re-implemented and ran the same construction locally: `readOnlyScopedUrl('postgresql://<redacted-userinfo>@host.example.com:5432/db?sslmode=require')` => '...?sslmode=require&options=-c%20default_transaction_read_only%3Don' (confirmed encodeURIComponent(' ')=='%20', no '+' anywhere); an existing options value is merged/space-joined rather than replaced (verified with a pre-existing options=-c%20statement_timeout%3D5000 input -> both clauses present, space-joined, still %20-encoded); the malformed-URL fallback branch also uses encodeURIComponent (no '+'); sslmode and all other pre-existing query params survive; userinfo/host/port/path come from the same URL object's own toString() and are untouched. Ran `node scripts/migration/db/readonly-url.selftest.mjs` myself: allPass=true, 5/5 scenarios pass (no-literal-+, sslmode kept, options merged, userinfo/host/port round-tripped, fallback branch also %20). Ran `node scripts/migration/db/runner-guards.selftest.mjs` myself: allPass=true, 7/7 scenarios pass, and `diff <(jq 'del(.checkedAt)' committed P1.1-runner-guards-selftest.json) <(jq 'del(.checkedAt)' my fresh run)` is empty -- no regression in the pre-existing guard logic. Re-ran the Sandbox proof myself against the real source, read-only: `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node scripts/migration/db/runner.mjs exec -- bash -lc 'psql "$SRC_URL_RO" -Atc "show default_transaction_read_only"'` => exitCode 0, stdout 'on'. `... exec -- bash -lc 'psql "$SRC_URL_RO" -c "BEGIN; CREATE TEMP TABLE _ro_probe(x int); ROLLBACK;"'` => BEGIN succeeds, then exitCode 1 with stderr 'ERROR: cannot execute CREATE TABLE in a read-only transaction' (the ROLLBACK never runs because the CREATE fails first, which is the expected/stronger outcome -- nothing persisted either way). This matches the db-operator's own P1.1-src-url-ro-fix.json report; I did not simply trust it, I reproduced every claim independently. No connection string was printed; all output was masked (://user:pass@ -> ://***:***@).
